_doc: Real-world plausibility priors for asset ingest verification. Matched by case-insensitive keyword against prim/file names. max_dim_m is the plausible range for the asset's largest bounding-box dimension in meters; mass_kg the plausible total mass; articulable=true means the object class normally has moving parts (absence of joints on a single fused mesh is a fidelity callout).

panic_bar_latch._doc: A push (panic) bar on one face retracts a latch; the leaf swings away from the bar's face. Used by scripts/door_draft.py; the latch itself is authored by scripts/add_mechanism.py.

buttons._doc: small parts standing proud of the body press in, sprung

multi_body._doc: A set of separate objects: every member gets its own rigid body and mass; members named like a surface keyword are the playing surface. Applied at ingest by ingest_asset.apply_set_physics. surface_approximation: a board is a slab, so a box is its exact collider; a convex hull of its square tiles let convex pieces fall straight through it in PhysX 110.

pet_food_bag._note: a flexible bag of loose kibble; simulated as one rigid body until granular contents and soft bags are supported (BACKLOG: granular)

pivot._doc: two blades on a revolute pivot at the screw

buttons._doc: small parts standing proud of the body press in, sprung

slide._doc: leaves slide sideways; bi-parting leaves move apart, coupled

mobile_robot.notes: A robot, not a prop: it needs its own articulation (URDF/CAD joints), not a drafted one.

bean_bag.notes: A bag of beads: a soft body (sponge preset) until granular filling is modelled.

laundry_hamper._doc: a fabric bag on a rigid folding frame: simulated as a rigid container

rotors._doc: each propeller spins on its motor

nail_clipper._doc: the lever swivels on the pin at the jaw end and presses about a horizontal fulcrum - not a scissor pivot (the pivot tier swung it flat about the wrong end); rigid until a lever tier exists

tweezers._doc: the arms flex at the root - a compliant mechanism, no pin: rigid until flex bodies

rubiks_cube._doc: the layers turn, but a cube's twist is a puzzle mechanic (rule-gated face rotation), not modelled: rigid

pivot._doc: two jaw/handle arms on a revolute pivot at the rivet: closed where the jaws meet, open_deg of travel from closed

tool_board._doc: a wall board holding a set of tools: each tool its own body

wheelchair._doc: a manual wheelchair: big drive (push) wheels and swivel casters (behaviors.wheeled_base)

power_wheelchair._doc: motor-driven wheels steered by a joystick, swivel casters (behaviors.wheeled_base)
